routes.summary: The new one-shot POST controller correctly moves the private GitHub token out of Preview build-time, but api/go-cycle-v2.js currently contains no caller-authentication/authorization gate and vercel.json contains no route-specific protection declaration. Vercel Deployment Protection may exist outside repo source, but the available get_project metadata does not attest an active ssoProtection state. Therefore the credential ingress remains AUTH_PROTECTION_UNVERIFIED and must fail closed before any real token POST.
routes.required_revalidation: Before any request carrying GITHUB_READ_TOKEN: attest active Vercel Deployment Protection for this exact Preview/deployment and prove an unauthenticated request is rejected before the function receives a body, OR add an independent operator-auth gate in the handler using a separate protected credential. Preserve POST-only/no-store/redaction/bounded-output and the command-scoped Sandbox forwarding fences. Do not use the GitHub read token itself as caller authentication. Do not trigger a credential-capable run until this gate and the exact-current source rebind are both satisfied.
